title: Site Reliability Engineer
body:
Ferrous runs payments infrastructure for marketplaces.

About the role

You will join a team of four SREs. We are looking for someone who has run production
systems at scale and can bring at least four years of that experience. Familiarity with
Go is expected, and you should be comfortable with Terraform and Kubernetes day to day.
Experience with incident command would be a plus, though we can teach it.

We work in a hybrid pattern, three days a week in the London office.

requirements.text: At least four years running production systems at scale
Comfortable with Terraform and Kubernetes day to day
